intents.name: Kolkata & Bengal Creator Discovery Engine
intents.description: Multi-source free creator discovery (chaining graph BFS, LLM citations, directory pages, topsearch grid, geo and hashtag sections) with exact provenance-stamped live follower auditing at a 10,000+ gate.

intents.name: FinTech 4-Tier 2-Year Collaboration Deep Scan
intents.description: Scrapes 53 Indian FinTech brands across 6 segments over a 2-year window (Aug 2024 - Aug 2026), detects boosted ad spend, checks Meta Paid Partnership toggle, and outputs 3-tab master Excel.

intents.name: Live Instagram Profile & Follower Verification
intents.description: Performs exact follower count audit, bio extraction, contact details, verification badge, and creator tier assignment via Playwright and curl_cffi.

intents.name: Paid Media Ad Spend & Boost Detection
intents.description: Analyzes a reel or post for paid media boost indicators (outlier view-to-follower multiplier, sub-0.35% like rate, play count discrepancies).
deliverables: Console diagnostic / JSON with is_boosted, boost_status, boost_reason

intents.name: List Master Workbooks & Datasets
intents.description: Lists all available finalized Excel workbooks, summary CSVs, and data caches in the repository with row counts and file sizes.

intents.name: Competitor Intelligence (Jewellery, Electronics, Footwear)
intents.description: Executes brand-specific omnichannel competitor research across GRT, Oriana, Palmonas, Giva, Croma, or Skechers.

intents.name: Hyperlocal Malls & Real Estate Footfall Intelligence
intents.description: Analyzes Pune, Hyderabad, and Bangalore retail malls, tenant directories, customer sentiment, and Google Maps Popular Times busyness.

intents.name: LLM Citation Discovery Prompt Builder
intents.description: Writes a category-parameterized prompts.csv for the quvoid/LLMxCitations scraper, and ingests its output.csv back into Instagram handle leads.
triggers: what does chatgpt say about creators

intents.name: Creator Intelligence Database Query
intents.description: Queries creator_intelligence.db - the permanent store of every creator, region, campaign and brand collaborator. Natural language, structured filters, or raw SQL. Query this BEFORE starting any new discovery run.

intents.name: Regional Creator Harvest, Audit and Deliver
intents.description: Any region, any category, any campaign. Cheap wide harvest (paginated geo and hashtag sweeps, chaining graph, YouTube, LLM citations, directory pages), then exact provenance-stamped auditing, then a client-ready workbook from a query.
options: deliver --region R --campaign C --residence N --min N --xlsx OUT

intents.name: LLM Creator Discovery (headless browser)
intents.description: Queries ChatGPT / duck.ai / Perplexity / Gemini through a real browser, extracts claimed handles AND person names, resolves the names to real Instagram handles via topsearch, and writes everything as PENDING_AUDIT leads. An LLM never contributes a follower number, only a name to verify.
